def factor_liquidity_impact_consensus(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    up_impact = intraday_ret.clip(lower=0.0) * np.where(is_high_vol > 0, 1.0, 0.3)
    down_impact = (-intraday_ret.clip(upper=0.0)) * np.where(is_low_vol > 0, 1.0, 0.3)
    up_vol = up_impact.ewm(span=20, min_periods=10).std()
    down_vol = down_impact.ewm(span=20, min_periods=10).std()
    denom = (up_vol + down_vol).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    asymmetry = (up_vol - down_vol) / denom
    valid = overnight_ret.notna() & intraday_ret.notna()
    same_sign = np.where(valid, np.sign(overnight_ret) == np.sign(intraday_ret), np.nan)
    rolling_agreement = pd.Series(same_sign, index=df_copy.index).rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    consensus_weight = 0.5 + rolling_agreement
    factor = asymmetry * consensus_weight
    df_copy["factor_liquidity_impact_consensus"] = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return df_copy["factor_liquidity_impact_consensus"]
description: Primary mechanism preserves the liquidity-conditioned asymmetric price impact from liq_vol_impact_asym_001: positive intraday moves on high-volume days reflect demand absorption, negative moves on low-volume days reflect illiquidity pressure. Borrowed lightweight idea from alpha-herding-0002 is the rolling session-sign agreement as a continuous confidence weight: higher overnight-intraday agreement indicates coordinated flow, amplifying the asymmetry signal; lower agreement dampens it. This keeps the raw signal continuous, bounded, and economically interpretable.
